mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: seeing nerves and blood routes reach the same muscles tied the earlier work together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the urinary organs was clear but mostly straightforward placement, so it felt less interesting than seeing the larger regions connect.

surprise.text: The diaphragm separating the chest from the abdomen helped me picture where those regions meet, while other routes still pass between them.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the named spaces and picture descriptions made the placements understandable, though the compatible-options menu supplied the pairings.

continue.text: I'd probably continue if another chapter explored how the assembled systems work together. The final cutaway made that interesting, although some of the individual fittings felt predictable.
